「はあ―――はあ、はあ――――」
　口元に込み上げる吐き気を手の平で押さえて、はあはあと呼吸を整える。

　なんだ、今のは。

lines.maoEnglish:
“――――――!”
I could bear it no longer and shot upright in bed.
“Hah―――hah, hah――――”
I clapped a hand over my mouth to contain the nausea and struggled to steady my breathing.
“Wh――――――”
What had that been?
A dream. I had been dreaming. But what kind of dream was that?
Dreaming of murdering someone and drinking their blood; something had to be wrong with me.

lines.japanese:
「……自分の部屋、だ」
　俺は紛れもなく自分の部屋にいる。
　ベッドで横になって、こうして朝を迎えている。
　……また、あの夢を見た。
　誰かの血を吸う夢。
　夢だって分かっているのに、ひどくリアルな夢。
　手には肉を引き千切る感触が残っていて、鼻にはまだ生臭い血の匂いが残留している―――
lines.label: s352
lines.maoEnglish:
“My room.”
There can be no doubt that I am in my own room.
I am lying in bed, greeting the morning.
I dreamed it again.
A dream of drinking someone’s blood.
I know it was a dream, yet it was hideously real.
My hands still remember tearing flesh, and the raw smell of blood still clings inside my nose―――

lines.maoEnglish:
“―――What is happening to me?”
I touch my throat.
The wound where Yumizuka bit me has long since closed.
I am still an ordinary human being.

“――――Ah.”
No. Yesterday was different. I―――
When I saw Kohaku’s throat, what did I think?
―――A white throat.
From the bottom of my heart, I wanted the red blood flowing through it――
